# monotaur_business_hours (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur business-hours schedule: the days and local time range during which a component is expected to be operational. The uptime endpoints count only time inside the business hours of a component (time outside counts neither for nor against uptime); the `monotaur_uptime_ratio` gauge does not apply them. Attach a schedule to a component with `monotaur_component.business_hours_id`; deleting the schedule detaches it from its components.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Office hours on weekdays, on the Berlin wall clock (daylight-saving aware).
resource "monotaur_business_hours" "office" {
  name         = "Office hours"
  days_of_week = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday"]
  start_time   = "08:00:00"
  end_time     = "18:00:00"
  time_zone_id = "Europe/Berlin"
}

# An overnight batch window: an end_time earlier than start_time ends on the
# following day. Without time_zone_id the times are UTC.
resource "monotaur_business_hours" "batch" {
  name         = "Nightly batch"
  days_of_week = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]
  start_time   = "22:00:00"
  end_time     = "06:00:00"
}

# Business hours are attached from the component side.
resource "monotaur_component" "payments" {
  name              = "Payments"
  business_hours_id = monotaur_business_hours.office.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `days_of_week` (Set of String) The days the time range applies to, as individual day names: any of `Sunday`, `Monday`, `Tuesday`, `Wednesday`, `Thursday`, `Friday`, `Saturday` (at least one). With an overnight range, the day is the one the range starts on.
- `end_time` (String) When the range ends, as a .NET TimeSpan (`hh:mm:ss`, greater than `00:00:00`; `1.00:00:00` means midnight at the end of the day, `24:00:00` is not accepted). Must differ from `start_time`; an `end_time` earlier than `start_time` is an overnight range that ends on the following day.
- `name` (String) The name of the business hours (1 to 250 characters, at least one letter). Must be unique.
- `start_time` (String) When the range starts each day, as a .NET TimeSpan offset into the local day (`hh:mm:ss`, from `00:00:00` up to but excluding 24 hours), e.g. `09:00:00`.

### Optional

- `time_zone_id` (String) The IANA (e.g. `Europe/Berlin`) or Windows (e.g. `W. Europe Standard Time`) time zone whose wall clock the times follow, including daylight-saving changes. Stored as written. When unset, times are UTC; removing it from the configuration clears it.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the business hours were created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the business hours (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the business hours were last updated (assigned by the API).
